name: GitHub for Startups Platform Credits
free_limit: Eligible approved startups receive $10,000 in one-time GitHub Enterprise platform credits valid for up to 12 months, usable toward eligible GitHub Enterprise, Copilot, Actions, Advanced Security and other platform charges.
watch_out: Requires affiliation with an approved startup partner, outside funding (Series B or earlier), a qualifying new/returning GitHub Enterprise Cloud account and no prior GitHub startup credits. A valid payment method is required; use after credit exhaustion or 12-month expiry automatically moves to paid billing. GitHub Enterprise Server and data-residency Enterprise accounts are excluded.
